services.overview: We build and deploy Small Language Models (SLMs) tailored to solve specific business challenges with maximum speed, minimal compute resources, and total data sovereignty. Unlike cloud-based massive LLMs, SLMs run directly on your own infrastructure or edge devices, eliminating ongoing API token charges, slashing response latencies to milliseconds, and guaranteeing that your sensitive data never leaves your organization.

benefits.title: Privacy & Sovereignty
benefits.text: Your confidential data never leaves your private network or third-party APIs.

benefits.title: Low Latency & Speed
benefits.text: Instant sub-second responses without relying on external cloud connectivity.

benefits.title: Zero Token Fees
benefits.text: Cut out recurring API bills by running self-hosted models on accessible hardware.

benefits.title: Domain-Specific Fine-Tuning
benefits.text: Models customized specifically for your technical jargon, internal docs, and processes.

faq.q: What is the difference between an SLM and a standard LLM?
faq.a: An SLM (Small Language Model) has between 1B and 8B parameters, enabling it to run on standard hardware (accessible GPUs or modern CPUs) with equal or better performance on specialized tasks, avoiding high costs and privacy concerns.

faq.q: What hardware is required to run an SLM?
faq.a: Thanks to modern quantization (GGUF, 4-bit/8-bit), many models run smoothly on standard enterprise servers, edge PCs, or workstations equipped with consumer/workstation GPUs (such as NVIDIA RTX) or fast CPU RAM.

faq.q: Can it integrate with our internal databases and documentation?
faq.a: Yes. We build local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and connectors to your internal databases, PDFs, ERP, and CRM systems so the model answers with verifiable internal facts.

services.overview: We design and deploy high-performance vector storage and retrieval architectures to empower generative AI applications, semantic search, and contextual data retrieval. We integrate top vector databases so your models and apps can find relevant context in milliseconds across millions of documents, images, or products.

benefits.title: True Semantic Search
benefits.text: Retrieve data by concept and meaning, not just exact keywords.

benefits.title: Massive Scalability

benefits.title: Zero AI Hallucinations

benefits.title: Ultra-Low Latency
benefits.text: Sub-10ms query responses even under heavy concurrent traffic.

faq.q: What is the difference between a vector database and a traditional database?
faq.a: Traditional databases match exact rows and keywords. Vector databases store mathematical representations (embeddings) that enable search by conceptual and semantic similarity.

faq.q: When should we use pgvector vs a dedicated engine like Qdrant?
faq.a: pgvector is great if you already use PostgreSQL and store up to hundreds of thousands of vectors. For multi-million scale or extreme speed, dedicated engines like Qdrant or Milvus are recommended.

faq.q: Can it integrate with our existing data sources?
faq.a: Yes, we build automated ETL pipelines that generate embeddings from your existing databases, documents, and CRMs.

faq.a: Yes, we implement strict pre-flight validation checks, detailed audit logs, and containment limits.

faq.q: How are system alerts delivered?

services.title: Middleware & System Integration
services.description: Connectors, event buses, and integration layers to connect disparate software, ERPs, APIs, and databases without friction.
features: Event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ
Unified REST and GraphQL API gateways over legacy databases
Real-time data transformation and schema mapping
Persistent queue management with retry policies and dead-letter queues
End-to-end transaction monitoring and message audit trails
services.overview: We connect your existing applications so they communicate seamlessly. We build high-throughput integration layers and message brokers that synchronize data between ERPs (SAP, Odoo), e-commerce platforms, payment processors, and banking systems with guaranteed delivery.

benefits.title: Connected Ecosystem
benefits.text: Continuous data flow across systems without manual double-entry.

benefits.title: Zero Lost Messages
benefits.text: Persistent message queues guarantee delivery even during outages.

benefits.title: Decoupled Architecture
benefits.text: Upgrade or replace individual apps without breaking the rest of your business.

benefits.title: Transactional Audit
benefits.text: Complete audit trail tracing every message, order, and payment event.

faq.q: Can legacy software without modern APIs be integrated?
faq.a: Yes, we integrate legacy systems via shared database triggers, flat files (CSV/XML), message queues, or custom micro-adapters.

faq.q: What happens if a downstream receiver goes offline?
faq.a: The middleware securely buffers messages in queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka) and delivers them automatically once the receiver recovers.

faq.q: How is data in transit secured?
faq.a: End-to-end TLS/SSL encryption, JWT authentication tokens, and cryptographic message signing.
